findings.title: unsubscribe crashes when no TopicUser record exists
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` can return nil (a user can receive a notification email for a topic without a topic_users row, e.g. mailing-list mode or a record cleaned up), and `notification_level` can also be NULL. The subsequent `tu.notification_level > ...` then raises NoMethodError on nil, giving a 500 to anyone following the unsubscribe link. Use `TopicUser.change(current_user.id, topic_id, notification_level: ...)` or create the record if missing.

findings.title: State-changing unsubscribe exposed over GET
findings.body: `unsubscribe` mutates the user's notification level on a plain GET request (routes.rb line 440/441) with `check_xhr` skipped and no token. Email clients, link prefetchers, antivirus scanners and third-party sites embedding the URL can silently mute topics for the user (CSRF-by-GET). The link should land on a confirmation page and perform the change via a POST/PUT with a signed key, as the existing `email/unsubscribe/:key` flow does.

findings.title: Repeat visits to unsubscribe URL mute the topic unexpectedly
findings.body: The toggle logic lowers watching/tracking to :regular on the first visit, but any subsequent hit of the same URL (back button, re-opening the email, prefetch) falls into the else branch and sets :muted. Combined with the email text/UI claiming 'You will stop receiving notifications', the resulting state is non-deterministic from the user's point of view. Make the endpoint idempotent (always target one level) or require an explicit confirmation action.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link translation now requires unsubscribe_url and will raise for other callers
findings.body: server.en.yml's `unsubscribe_link` now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}`, but `unsubscribe_url` is only supplied by `UserNotifications#send_notification_email`. Any other build_email call that passes `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without `unsubscribe_url` will make `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` in both `body` and `html_part`, breaking those emails. Either default `unsubscribe_url` in `@template_args` or guard the interpolation.

findings.title: topicUnsubscribe route shadowed by topic fromParamsNear
findings.body: The `topic` resource declared above defines `fromParamsNear` with path `/:nearPost` under `/t/:slug/:id`, so `/t/slug/123/unsubscribe` is matched first with nearPost='unsubscribe' and never reaches the new `topicUnsubscribe` route. The unsubscribe page will not render client-side (and the post stream request with a non-numeric nearPost will fail). The new route must be declared before the topic resource or nested with a numeric constraint.

findings.title: Misspelled property name stopNotificiationsText
findings.body: The computed property is spelled `stopNotificiationsText` ('Notificiations') here and in templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs. While consistent today, the typo is part of the public controller API and will break silently if anyone fixes one side; rename both to `stopNotificationsText`.

findings.title: No specs for the new unsubscribe endpoint
findings.body: The new `TopicsController#unsubscribe` action (auth requirement, slug redirect, nil TopicUser, level toggling) and `Topic#unsubscribe_url` have no request/model specs. Given the nil-dereference and toggle semantics above, these paths are untested and regressions will ship silently.
